scope: Reviewed billing protocol obligations; partial bounded coverage, not a complete financial or backend specification.
notes: Command families have different authorities and must not be collapsed into one enum-only model.
Pending model registration is coordinated through contracts.json by the root agent.
No model establishes provider correctness or live database refinement.

invariants: A server-owned reservation settles at most once.
Refunds never exceed the original reservation; collected money is conserved.
assumptions: Finite models cover only their documented bounds; implementation refinement is not established.
Provider truth, network effects, database isolation and cryptographic validation need independent evidence.
remainingWork: Model multiple organizations, allowance funding, affiliate allocation and decimal rounding.

invariants: Failed rows do not block later rows within the admitted run budget.

assumptions: Finite models cover only their documented bounds; implementation refinement is not established.
Provider truth, network effects, database isolation and cryptographic validation need independent evidence.
remainingWork: Model independent cron workers, live insertion and durable retry fairness beyond one bounded run.

invariants: Only the live scope/token/revision/generation owner can commit provider progress.

assumptions: Finite models cover only their documented bounds; implementation refinement is not established.

remainingWork: Connect the bounded lease model to real Postgres contention and provider-idempotency tests.
Model individual cancellation, import, scheduled downgrade and deletion authorities.

invariants: At most one blocking attempt exists per organization.
Provider uncertainty retains the original idempotency identity and request snapshot.
Credit application is atomic; credited terminal state follows cache invalidation.
Replay preserves the balance-decrease revision covered by the original credit.
assumptions: Finite models cover only their documented bounds; implementation refinement is not established.

invariants: The paid provider session must match the original server quote.

Their composition and correspondence to the TypeScript implementation remain unproved.
remainingWork: Verify complete provider receipt provenance, delayed arrival and recovery interleavings against the implementation.

invariants: Each wallet/network has one outstanding signed nonce authority.
A pending transaction or missing response cannot release signed authority.
An account cascade cannot erase an unconfirmed EVM sweep.
Terminal recovery cannot issue a new signed transaction.
Receipt publication and deletion acquire payment before outbox so the two transactions cannot form a reverse row-lock cycle.
assumptions: Two outboxes, one wallet/network, chain nonces zero through two.
One matching successful receipt establishes nonce consumption; reorgs and provider dishonesty are excluded.
The lock model covers one payment, one outbox and two transactions. It excludes unrelated lock orders and makes no scheduling fairness claim.
remainingWork: Prove implementation refinement and composition with payment crediting and full account deletion.
Model Solana replacement and deletion separately.
Resolve reverted EVM sweeps and indefinite unavailable provider receipts without inventing success.
Profile and bound historical legacy-identity migration under a large mixed-wallet backlog.
